result.rationale: Wafra's 2022 acquisition remains active and Wafra currently classifies CLC in Real Assets & Infrastructure. CLC is a fleet-based trailer/chassis lessor, not a debt-only or pure-finance exposure. No exit or pending transfer was found.

identityResolution.boundary: One CLC platform; units, branches, depots and services stay beneath it. No separate alias-based company or duplicate was supported.
identityResolution.legalIdentity: Acquisition holdco/legal purchaser and state-incorporation details are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.

currentOwners.stake: Acquisition interest; exact control and percentage NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED

ownershipResolution.transaction: Funds advised by Wafra acquired CLC; exact vehicle, family/employee sellers, price and percentages are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
ownershipResolution.founder: Founder Michael Goor remained a significant shareholder at entry and is current President/CEO; current exact percentage is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
ownershipResolution.currentProof: Current Wafra portfolio and board disclosures plus CLC's Wafra equity-partner statement.

operatingResolution.model: CLC operates and leases a long-life trailer/intermodal-chassis fleet and also provides sales, maintenance, roadside and consulting services.
operatingResolution.fleet: About 15,700 units in 2022; 18,000 in CLC's January 2024 release; no newer direct figure opened.
operatingResolution.facilitiesGeography: 13 branches/depots in 2022 and January 2024, mainly east of the Mississippi at entry; headquarters in New Jersey.
operatingResolution.customers: Private fleets, carriers/3PLs, drayage and cold-chain users.

acquisitionExitCheck.closing: The 2022-08-02 release describes an acquisition, so that date is treated as entry; a separate legal closing date is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
acquisitionExitCheck.status: No public sale, recapitalization, exit or signed pending transaction was located through the cutoff; current sources support continued ownership.

milestones.event: Wafra-advised funds acquired CLC; Goor stayed CEO/significant shareholder; about 15,700 units and 13 branches/depots.
Current Wafra portfolio/board pages and CLC's equity-partner statement support active ownership.
